title: Shopping 3
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. a1_shopping (34) and a2_shopping (26) own the counter: money, price, cost, cheap, expensive, buy, sell, pay, cash, card, receipt, size, discount, sale, offer, refund, queue, checkout, wallet, brand, product, bargain, purchase, quality, item. The sweep dropped guarantee, exchange, second-hand and subscription as already taught, and the corrected pool caught **haggle**, taught this morning by leaf_money_b2 whose node is still `coming` — eighth self-collision avoided that way. What is left is everything that happens either side of paying: how people actually shop now (shop around, browse, impulse buy, loyalty card, voucher, cashback, self-checkout, click and collect, courier), what you need when it goes wrong (faulty, warranty, returns policy, proof of purchase, out of stock, overpriced, hidden charges, small print, cooling-off period), and buying outside a shop (charity shop, car boot sale, auction, bid, own brand, price match). The second board is the practical one: a B2 speaker can buy a thing but cannot complain about it, and *faulty*, *proof of purchase* and *cooling-off period* are exactly the words a shop assistant will use back at them. C57 card 0 recaps Shopping 1 and 2. E10 Use is rewrite production.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Shopping 1 and 2 gave you the counter — money, price, cheap, expensive, buy, sell, pay, cash, card, receipt, size, discount, sale, offer, refund, queue, checkout, brand, product, bargain, quality. Those carry the sentences here. What is new is everything on either side of paying: how people shop now, and what you say when the thing you bought is wrong.
cards.note_cz: Shopping 1 a 2 ti daly pult — money, price, cheap, expensive, buy, sell, pay, cash, card, receipt, size, discount, sale, offer, refund, queue, checkout, brand, product, bargain, quality. Ta slova nesou zdejší věty. Nové je všechno okolo placení: jak lidé nakupují dnes a co řekneš, když je s koupenou věcí něco špatně.

cards.title: Taking something back
points: This is the board that matters. You can buy a thing already — the hard part is complaining.
These four words are what the shop will say back to you.

rows: the thing is broken, and that is their problem
the rules about how long you have
the days you can change your mind, online
